name: Interoceptive Inference
description: Predictive processing of bodily signals: the brain maintains generative models of internal physiological states and updates them using interoceptive inputs from heart, lungs, gut, etc. Underlies emotion, pain perception, and homeostatic regulation.
key_references: Seth, A. K. (2013). Interoceptive inference, emotion, and the embodied self. Trends in Cognitive Sciences, 17(11), 565-573.
Barrett, L. F., & Simmons, W. K. (2015). Interoceptive predictions in the brain. Nature Reviews Neuroscience, 16(7), 419-429.
empirical_evidence: fMRI shows insula encodes heartbeat, respiration, and gut signals. Lesions to insula impair emotion and pain perception. Interoceptive accuracy predicts cardiac perception and emotional awareness. Evidence for prediction errors in interoception emerging. Computational models less developed than visual prediction.
